summary: Both editions were reviewed clause by clause against the selected working Greek; the simplified edition was also compared with the standard. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the distinct rod groups, withheld repentance, renewed seal, plural spirits, complete loss to God, categorical negation, and repentance requirement. The reader-facing terminology follows current policy. The notes distinguish editorial supplements from preserved wording and disclose the bounded sinners reading, the historical sins alternative, and partial Michigan preservation without counting Athos editions as independent manuscripts. Acceptance is limited to these supplied texts and their disclosures; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, verify archived files, or certify exhaustive collation.
